linhagens.texto: A pravastatina é obtida por hidroxilação microbiana da mevastatina (compactina, ML-236B), policetídeo fúngico inibidor da HMG-CoA redutase.
linhagens.trecho: This compound is obtained by hydroxylation of ML-236B (mevastatin) in Streptomyces carbophilus catalyzed by a cytochrome P-450sca monooxygenase system.

referencia.titulo: A two component-type cytochrome P-450 monooxygenase system in a prokaryote that catalyzes hydroxylation of ML-236B to pravastatin, a tissue-selective inhibitor of 3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl coenzyme A reductase.

linhagens.texto: A atorvastatina, inibidor totalmente sintético da HMG-CoA redutase, teve como composto-líder inicial a compactina (mevastatina), metabólito fúngico.
linhagens.trecho: This study culminated in the discovery of atorvastatin which has a five times greater potency then the initial lead, the fungal metabolite compactin

referencia.titulo: An overview of the key routes to the best selling 5-membered ring heterocyclic pharmaceuticals.

linhagens.texto: A varfarina saiu da série de anticoagulantes sintetizados a partir do dicumarol, que se forma pela oxidação microbiana da cumarina no feno de trevo-doce mofado.
linhagens.trecho: which was formed by microbial induced oxidation of coumarin in the mouldy sweet clover hay. More than hundred dicoumarol-like anticoagulants were synthesized by Link and his co-workers. A potent hemorrhagic agent named warfarin was first used as an effective rat poison.

referencia.titulo: [On the history of vitamin K, dicoumarol and warfarin].

linhagens.texto: O lapachol, naftoquinona natural, está na origem da atovaquona, hidroxinaftoquinona sintética usada contra a malária.
linhagens.trecho: three of the mainstays of malaria treatment come from natural products: quinine, lapachol (which led to atovaquone) and artemisinin.

referencia.titulo: The global pipeline of new medicines for the control and elimination of malaria.

linhagens.texto: A mefloquina, quinolinometanol sintético, é análogo estrutural dos alcaloides de Cinchona quinina e quinidina.
linhagens.trecho: The quinoline methanol antimalarial drug mefloquine is a structural analogue of the Cinchona alkaloids, quinine and quinidine.

referencia.titulo: Alkoxide coordination of iron(III) protoporphyrin IX by antimalarial quinoline methanols: a key interaction observed in the solid-state and solution.

linhagens.texto: A pentoxifilina, 1-(5-oxo-hexil)-3,7-dimetilxantina, é derivado sintético da teobromina.
linhagens.trecho: Pentoxifylline (PTX), a derivative of the methylxanthine theobromine, has been used for many years in the treatment of peripheral vascular diseases.

referencia.titulo: Pharmacological aspects of pentoxifylline with emphasis on its inhibitory actions on hepatic fibrogenesis.

linhagens.texto: O ácido acetilsalicílico (aspirina) é a forma acetilada do ácido salicílico, preparada por Felix Hoffmann na Bayer em 1897.
linhagens.trecho: Felix Hoffman, working at the Bayer company in Germany, made the acetylated form of salicylic acid in 1897. This drug was named "Aspirin" and became the most widely used medicine of all time.

referencia.titulo: The mechanism of action of aspirin.

linhagens.texto: A cevimelina (SNI-2011, AF102B) foi desenhada como análogo rígido da acetilcolina, agonista dos receptores muscarínicos.
linhagens.trecho: (SNI-2011, cevimeline hydrochloride), a rigid analogue of acetylcholine

referencia.titulo: (+/-)-cis-2-methylspiro[1,3-oxathiolane-5,3'-quinuclidine] hydrochloride, hemihydrate (SNI-2011, cevimeline hydrochloride) induces saliva and tear secretions in rats and mice: the role of muscarinic acetylcholine receptors.
